question: 介绍一下他的项目
answer: 他目前最有代表性的项目之一是「个人作品集 + AI 助手」——一个他独立开发的全栈网站，内置 AI 聊天助手（DeepSeek + RAG 检索 + 代码知识库向量检索）、邮箱验证码登录、私聊申请与自动邮件、以及站长后台管理。此外还有：AI 二手车估价平台（Go + Next.js + TypeScript，异步 AI 请求成功率 95%）、油气管道实时监控仪表盘（React + C# + SQL Server + Python ETL）、以及基于 Modbus TCP 的 PLC 工业数据采集系统（Python + Tkinter + Flask）。完整项目列表可在「项目作品」页面查看。
answer_en: One of his most representative projects is the 'Portfolio + AI Assistant' — a full-stack site he built solo, featuring an AI chat assistant (DeepSeek + RAG retrieval + code knowledge base), email-verification login, private-chat requests with automated emails, and an owner admin panel. His other projects include: an AI used-car valuation platform (Go + Next.js + TypeScript, 95% async request success rate), a pipeline & asset monitoring dashboard (React + C# + SQL Server + Python ETL), and an industrial PLC data acquisition system over Modbus TCP (Python + Tkinter + Flask). See the Projects page for the full list.

question: 他擅长什么技术
answer: 他擅长全栈开发：前端方面熟悉 React、Next.js、TypeScript、Tailwind CSS、Zustand；后端方面擅长 C#/ASP.NET Core、Go、Node.js、Python、Java/Spring Boot；数据库方面熟悉 SQL Server、PostgreSQL、MySQL、Supabase、Redis；并有 AI 应用实践（DeepSeek API、RAG/pgvector 向量检索、代码知识库），以及工业通信协议（Modbus TCP）和云平台（AWS EC2、Vercel）的经验。日常使用 Git、Docker、Linux 环境进行开发，并熟练运用 AI 工具（Deepseek Harness / Claude Code）提升开发效率。
answer_en: He specializes in full-stack development: frontend (React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Zustand), backend (C#/ASP.NET Core, Go, Node.js, Python, Java/Spring Boot), and databases (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Supabase, Redis). He also has hands-on AI experience (DeepSeek API, RAG/pgvector retrieval, code knowledge base), industrial communication protocols (Modbus TCP), and cloud platforms (AWS EC2, Vercel). He uses Git, Docker, and Linux daily, and leverages AI tools (Deepseek Harness / Claude Code) to accelerate development.
